steps: Rinse the rice under cold water; cook it in the unsalted vegetable broth in a medium saucepan over medium heat for 18 minutes, until tender.
Dice the onion and mince the garlic; cut the zucchini into small 1 cm cubes.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic; cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until softened.
Stir in the ground cumin and sweet paprika; cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the zucchini cubes and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly tender.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and drained cooked chickpeas; stir to combine.
Simmer over medium-low heat for 8 to 10 minutes, until the sauce thickens and the zucchini is soft.
Stir in the lemon juice and serve the chickpea mixture over the cooked rice. Yield: 4 family portions. Refrigerate for up to 3 days.
